owner: Admitted channel session and shared boss/instance admission owners
offer_gate: ARENA-1: only a node serving a World booted from a bundle offers this capability (BUNDLE_WORLD_OFFERED_CAPABILITIES); fixture worlds never offer it. Command 240 reads the Svargrond challenge catalogue and command 436 reads or changes the current arena match through the admitted, session-generation-fenced durable owner. Both commands require capability 170 to be selected.
